final: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10 WITH TIES
